How to read this page

Availability says whether you can use the surface now. Lifecycle says where it stands in its release process. A surface can be live and in soak at once: usable today, still inside its post-release observation window, with graduation a recorded gate decision — never a date passing quietly.

This page, status.json, the service record, and the llms.txt status section are all generated from one source; CI drift checks fail the build when any rendering disagrees with it.
